 Who's Missing: Konsa 'fine' for Arsenal while Leeds striker Calvert-Lewin uncertain 
 Who's Missing: Konsa 'fine' for Arsenal while Leeds striker Calvert-Lewin uncertain
 Flashscore UK Staff Arsenal defender Ezri Konsa has been cleared to play against Hull John Walton, PA Images / Alamy / Profimedia Arsenal defender Ezri Konsa has been declared "fine" to play against Hull by manager Mikel Arteta after being substituted in the Champions League win over Slavia Prague. Who's missing across Gameweek 10?
 Leeds duo Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Anton Stach are doubts to face Tottenham and are both expected to be game-time decisions.
 Elsewhere, Ryan Gravenberch is at risk of missing Liverpool's fixture at Crystal Palace after missing their Champions League defeat to Fenerbahce with a heel injury.

 Win probability Flashscore Everton's summer recruit Hayden Hackney has lost a career-high six head-to-heads against Coventry and has been at the thick of the action across his last five league meetings (A1, YC4, RC1).
 Coventry's Taiwo Awoniyi may have been on target last weekend against Sunderland, but his seven club goals prior all came on the road. 
 Everton's Tyrique George picked up a late knock against Newcastle, while Coventry's defensive lynchpin Bobby Thomas missed the win against Sunderland.

 Win probability Flashscore Leeds striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin has scored or assisted in three of his last five appearances against Tottenham, with his club picking up points in all three (W1, D2).
 Mathys Tel rounded off Spurs' win away to Chelsea and has now scored six of his eight goals for the club after half-time, including against Leeds last season.
 Noah Okafor is a doubt after missing Leeds' last match with a groin problem, whilst Tottenham will assess Lucas Bergvall and Tosin Adarabioyo closer to matchday.

 Win probability Flashscore Declan Rice has five open-play Premier League assists this season, the most he's ever recorded in one campaign, with three of the last four of those coming after the 55th minute.
 Oliver McBurnie became the first player to score a direct free-kick in the Premier League for Hull since December 2016 when doing so against Ipswich (D 2-2), while three of his last four goals came after the hour mark.
 Max Dowman is suspended for Arsenal, while the same goes for Hull's Matt Crooks.

 Win probability Flashscore Only three players start the round having had more touches in the opposition box than Fulham's Oscar Bobb (50), whose last five goals for club or country have come in the first or final 15 minutes.
 Newcastle's Harvey Barnes has scored three times on his last four Premier League visits to Craven Cottage, while six of his last eight Premier League strikes came after half-time.
 Fulham look to have no fresh issues, while Newcastle's absentee list now includes the suspended Jacob Ramsey.

 Win probability Flashscore Morgan Gibbs-White is set to make his 200th Premier League appearance here, with his 151 for Forest representing the third-most for the club in the competition - he assisted the winner in their only head-to-head victory since promotion.
 City's Erling Haaland leads the way in the Premier League with nine goals, four of which were match openers, but he's not been involved in a goal in the last three league head-to-heads. 
 Neither side seemingly have any fresh injury concerns.

 Palace will be missing two of their most prominent attacking options in Ismaila Sarr and Jean-Philippe Mateta, while Liverpool's Ryan Gravenberch will be monitored having missed their midweek game.
